relationships.subject: CCL25
relationships.evidence_quote: CSF levels of CCL25 was a significant regressor regarding general fatigue, with an R<sup>2</sup> = 0.47.

relationships.subject: blood-brain barrier permeability
relationships.evidence_quote: BBB permeability was significantly correlated to the quotients of 35 cytokines and to the CSF levels of 11 cytokines.

key_findings: CSF CCL25 was a significant negative regressor of general fatigue in chronic pain patients (R2 = 0.47 with depression and rest pain).
BBB permeability correlated with serum-CSF cytokine quotients; no cytokines were associated with sleep disturbance.
